significance: A Shiva temple at Nandivaram near Guduvancheri, with the lingam of Nandeesvarar in the sanctum and a separate shrine for the goddess Soundaranayaki. It serves as the principal temple of the town.
story: A herdboy is said to have noticed that one cow gave its milk each day at a particular spot and came home dry; when the spot was dug, a lingam was found rising from the ground.
